batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c LR Shukla b JD Unadkat

batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c SC Ganguly b JD Unadkat

batting.name: AC Voges
batting.dismissal: c M Kartik b AB Dinda

batting.name: AS Raut
batting.dismissal: c CH Gayle b JD Unadkat

batting.name: SK Trivedi
batting.dismissal: c JD Unadkat b AB Dinda

batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c SR Watson b Kamran Khan

balls.text: slower short ball, pulled limply down the ground, enough time to come back for two
Mother of all ironies. Sid Trivedi getting out to a slower one. Ends up skying it towards midwicket and Unadkat gets under it and completes the catch even as he takes a tumble
inside edge for four, makes room early, Dinda goes for the stumps, and the inside edge beats both the stumps and the keeper

good work from Unadkat and McCullum. They risk a second to deep square leg, and Unadkat throws flat and slightly off the mark. McCullum comes forward to make up for the throw, collects it in front of his body, and reverse-flicks the bails off to find his short by inches
quick yorker outside off, another dot
slower ball, passes under the bat of Fazal who is backing away
another yorker outside off, another dot
yorker outside off, Warne nowhere near him
yorker, would have been dot but for an unnecessary underarm flick from McCullum, which allows them one overthrow
Fazal finally gets a boundary, after 38 balls without one. Sits back, is expecting a short one, and pulls it over midwicket
just back of a length, just outside off, hit straight to point, too much of a quick one this is for Warne, and he turns the single down
good save by McCullum, it is a big wide down the leg side, McCullum dives and saves three. First wide of the innings!
short ball, he is expecting it, rocks back and pulls, but gets just a single
opens the face to get one, good finish by Kartik after being given a bit of stick by Watson early on
flat, pulled to deep square for one
Rajasthan are falling apart here. Tries to reverse-hit, the ball pitches in the rough outside what would be the leg stump, turns away, beats him, and takes out the middle stump
full ball, hit to long-on, will get just a single
makes room and late-cuts this to short third for one
flighted outside off, driven to sweeper-cover for one
back of a length, pushed to long-off for one
in the block hole, gets a single to long-on
driven with an open face, gets a single to deep point
another misfield by Dinda! Again a superb catch followed by ordinary fielding. It's a yorker dug out towards short fine, Dinda attacks the ball but doesn't get low enough and concedes two extra runs
angled across him, he opens the face to gets a single to third man
slower short ball, pulled down to long-on for one
runs it down to third man for one

another superb catch. By Gayle this time. Raut is frustrated and he jumps out of the track, and is done in by yet another slower delivery. Gayle runs backwards from mid-off and takes a nice head-high catch
short ball, no pace on it, 116ks, hit down to long-on
back of a length, no room, hit back to the bowler
stays a touch low, he recovers well to work it to midwicket
slower ball, looks to run it past the keeper, but there isn't much pace on it and hence it can't get wide of McCullum
wicket-maiden! digs this one in short, gets extra bounce, beats his attempt at a late-cut
full and fast, defended back to the bowler
this short one kicks at him, from back of a length, and it is pretty close to the glove as he is surprised with the bounce
another short one, sways out of the line

he is early into the pull again, and he has dragged this one from wide outside off onto the stumps, off the bottom edge. It;s not a slower one either, 138ks, Kolkata have made a big comeback into this match
starts off with a short one, and Finch is early into the pull
another slower ball outside, punched away for one
gets an inside edge on a slower delivery, and takes a single
low full toss, hit straight to long-on for one
no mistake with this one, done in by a slower one! Is looking for a loft, but ends up skying it towards wide long-on, and Kartik completes a safe catch
nearly a yorker, dug out for a single to long-on
short, and cut away to third man for one
Tiwary fumbles this time, at wide long-on, lets them go back for two
turned to midwicket for one
driven to sweeper-cover for one
goes for a drive outside off, is beaten
full and outside off, driven with an open face towards third man, and this time Bond misfields
another slower legcutter, it's a loopy full toss this time, and Finch muscles it over midwicket for six

Dinda misfields at long-off. The story of the tournament really, brilliant work followed by ordinary stuff. Voges dances down the track and hits this towards long-off, Dinda lets it go through on the second bounce
short and wide, cut away for one
full and flat, defended back to the bowler
driven wide of long-off for one
flighted on the pads, misses but gets a leg-bye
tosses this one nicely, ends up yorking him
cut away to third man for one
opens the face to get off the mark
hit powerfully down the ground, but into the stumps at the non-striker's end
pushed down to long-on for one

As good as a catch as Ganguly has ever taken! And it is some take! Yusuf gets too much under this attempted six off a slower ball, and skies it towards deep midwicket, and Ganguly runs back from midwicket, keeps his eye on it, and then in the final instance sees it is falling away, and then dives to complete the stunner
slower ball, pushed down to long-on for one
driven inside-out to sweeper-cover for one
full toss, hit down to long-on for one
length ball, hit powerfully back at Shukla, who gets a hand to it, and Yusuf sends Finch back
another slower ball, into the pads, worked away for one
slower ball, 12oks, but hit forcefully back at him, and wide enough of him
into the block hole, dug out back to the bowler
back of a length, outside off, moves across and defends
welcomed with a short delivery outside off, which he leaves alone

Shukla is everywhere! Lovely catch at point, diving full length to his left after this was crashed off the back foot by Ojha. It was a poor delivery, short and wide, but Shukla threw himself at it, full length
he is expecting a full one, and drives it past extra cover for four
another short one, left alone this time, called one for the over
looks to tuck him up with a short one, easily pulled away for one
walks down the wicket to push one down to long-on
Kartik's horrible day continues, Pathan heaves a back-of-a-length delivery, Kartik does the running from deep square to his left, manages to get under it thanks to a dive, but can't hold on to it
defends the first ball he faces, to cover
big wicket, slower short one, Watson waits and waits before pulling, and it has a loopy sort of bounce, and dips as it reaches, and Watson misses it altogether
shuffles too far across, Shukla misses the leg stump by inches, and in a positive bit of umpiring, it is not called no-ball
starts up with a pitched-up delivery, driven down to long-on
tossed up, Ojha presses forward to defend
pitched up, pushed to long-on
he manufactures the short length again, rocking back to pull a length delivery, and he ends up hitting it back at Kartik, and forcefully enough for Kartik to not be interested in
punched away, lovely timing, it is just back of a length, but he rocks back and hits it on the up past sweeper-cover
another single pushed down to long-on
full ball, pushed to long-on for one
Ganguly makes a diving one-handed save at mid-on, it was a slower ball that Watson had managed to hit wide of mid-on, but Ganguly was up to the task
short and wide, cut away, but doesn't find the gap at cover
square-drive, in the air, clears the infield, he is loving the gentle pace and length Unadkat is providing
poor fielding, cut away to point, Kartik misfields, allowing a single, and then Tiwary misses a direct hit to allow an overthrow
pulled away off the front foot, gentle pace, back of a length, and he launches it over midwicket
back of a length, around middle, defended, and they steal a quick run
right up in the block hole, pushed back
fuller delivery, defended back to the bowler
pulled away, creates the length by going deep in the crease, wide of long-on
short, and pulled over midwicket
pushed back to the bowler
Watson plays for spin, and is beaten by the straighter one
short, down the leg side, pulled away for four. Did they cross before the ball reached the boundary? Thanks for coming, Rajasthan
fuller ball, cramps him up, hit back to the bowler
another long hop, and and Ganguly gives it the treatment, stands back and lofts this to the other side of long-on this time
long hop, asking to be hit, Ganguly clears the front leg and pulls it over cow corner
makes room, hits a short ball to wide of long-off for two
comes down the track, nearly yorks himself up, takes a single to long-on
cut away to deep point for one
shapes up for the scoop over short fine, Trivedi goes full and wide outside off, and he changes the shot to push it into the covers
slower ball again, pulls it down to long-off for one
slower ball, beats him as he looks to give Trivedi the charge
short and wide again, and runs this down to third man for one
smart shot! this is short and wide outside off, and he deliberately goes over mid-on because Trivedi has an off-heavy field
and Ganguly is even more urgent after the time-out. Short ball too, asking to be hit, and he pulls it past deep midwicket
full, around off, driven with an open face for one
cramps him up with sharp turn into the pads
short, turning into the body, pulled over square leg
flighted outside off, left alone. Ganguly looks for a wide call but it has turned back enough
punches it against the turn, finds straightish extra cover
comes down the track, and bunts this into the on side for one
flighted outside off, pushed down to long-off for one
gives him the charge, Voges looks for the leg-side stumping, but he gets bat on it
long hop, rocks back and pulls him over square leg. Clean connection
short and wide, cut away to the left of sweeper-cover, but they take just a single
flighted outside off, turning away, left alone
goes inside-out, gets under this full delivery, and lofts him over wide long-off
full outside off, hit back to the bowler
late-cuts this past short third man for one
some urgency, shimmies down the track and also across the stumps, and sweeps this from outside off for four
makes room, drives inside-out, gets a single to deep point
charges at him, and pushes a shortish delivery to deep midwicket
fired into the pads, worked away
Ganguly opens up, makes room, gets under a full delivery, and chips it over extra cover
this time connects with the cut, gets a single to sweeper-cover
arm ball, beats him on the cut, Ojha belts out another unnecessary long irritating appeal which has become a feature with almost all IPL wicketkeeepers
angled into the pads, worked around the corner
paddled away from in front of stumps to fine of fine leg
arm ball, hurries him up, but the pull shot finds midwicket
short and wide, the cut shot finds point
short and wide again, cut away square for one
brilliant fielding by Voges at short cover. Short and wide, cut away powerfully, but Voges dives to his left to deny them even one run
swept away from leg-stump line for a single
flighted wide outside off, square-driven to point
paddled away from in front of stumps, comes back for two
flighted outside off, driven to sweeper-cover
cut away against the turn, past short third man
short, and turning down the leg side
angled into the pads, worked away for one
slightly slower and fuller, defended to cover
nicely played, using Yusuf's pace, and the sharp turn, and guiding this late past Watson at slip
sharp turn, angled in from round the stumps, pitches off and middle and beats a defensive poke
short ball, pulled down to long-on for one
pitched up on the pads, worked around the corner for one
long hop, outside off, but he pulls it against the turn and bisects long-on and deep midwicket
pushed to cover for a single
that's wide down the leg side not called, Ojha's unbelievably long appeal has something to do with it?

missed stumping! Warne does him in, but Ojha doesn't play ball. Ganguly charges at him, short and flat on middle, turning down the leg side, Ojha makes the wide collection but misses the stumps as he goes for the stumping
dip and turn, pitched outside leg, turning towards middle, worked away to square leg for one
flighted outside off, some dip there, Ganguly drops and runs to point, Kamran running in doesn't pick it cleanly. Would have been close
slower ball, hit back at him, Trivedi gets a left hand on it
short and wide, this time he gets close to it, and cuts it in front of point. Good connection on it, and beats a dive from Yusuf Pathan at the boundary
short and wide, no feet as he cuts, away from his body, gets it to point on the bounce
slower ball, half-volley, but Ganguly is caught at the back foot and pushes it down to long-off for one
punched straight to short extra cover, on the bounce
back of a length, angled across him, defended to short cover
back of a length, no room, turned to square leg
slower ball, too full and too wide, but Pujara finds cover on the drive
short delivery, Pujara sways out, sees tennis-ball bounce, and looks to upper-cut it, but misses
fuller ball, and Pujara whips it past mid-on, all wrists there, all along the ground
some nip in, back of a length, just outside off, and jagging back in, defended back to the bowler
back of a length, turned to square leg, another dot
short, into the body, and pulled away, over square leg
too short, too high, called wide
on the pads, whipped away for one to fine leg
slower ball, pushed to point, Ganguly sends Pujara back, then thinks of a single off misfield but decides against it
short, into the ribs, fended away for one to fine leg
short and wide, cut away to third man for one
another full toss from Kamran, driven towards cover, Fazal dives, Ganguly sends Pujara back
short, gives him width, cut on the bounce to short point
slower ball, full and wide, pushed to straightish extra cover
another of Ganguly specials. Undoes the tight off-side field, clearing his front leg and pulling this short ball over midwicket. Smart shot
gets the width this time, looks to cut, but is beaten by slight extra bounce
back of a length, rearing into the ribs zone, defended with soft hands
back of a length, outside off, defended
what a start! square punch! short and wide, and he sends it crashing past point
timber! Kamran has turned this game around. For the moment at least. Gayle looks to defend, playing for the swing, and this one goes in with the angle, and squeezes through the bat-pad gap
slight swing away from Gayle, left alone
length ball, outside off, pushed back to the bowler
he has hit a juicy leg-side full toss straight down Watson's throat at square leg. Lucky dismissal if ever there was one
short and wide, doesn't get power into the cut
angled across the stumps, pushed to point
enough of the short-pitched business! At Watson's pace at least. Gives himself slight room, and upper-cuts him over point, one bounce for four
gets the length ball, clears the front leg to try and crash it past cover, but is beaten
short, just outside off, defended towards point
on the pads, worked past short fine for one
shot! shimmies down the track and lofts him inside-out, over extra cover
length ball outside off, driven one the bounce to cover
pushed with soft hands to mid-off, and rushes through for one
fired into the pads, gets a top edge on the attempted paddle, it falls short of short fine
and again he makes room and cuts him from outside leg, past point
full on pads, misses as he looks to turn it to leg
short and even wider down the leg side
expectedly he goes full and even wider down the leg side
shot! makes room and cuts it from outside leg stump to do undo with his leg-stump line
flat around middle, gets an inside edge, which is safe
